messages:
maria: Heads-up — the Next.js RAG starter import job breaks when upgrading SDK 0.6.1 -> 0.7.0. Getting ModuleNotFound on llamaindex adapter and the ingest worker stalls on auth retries. Repro below.

jon: repro steps? paste logs/snippet?

maria: logs:```
Error: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'redwood.llamaindex_adapter'
During batch ingest: 401 received, retry loop but no token refresh hook executed.
```

kevin: looks like SDK moved integration exports and renamed hooks. starter still imports old path, and the retryer callback changed name.

sam: I reproduced. Worker retries on 401 forever because the starter didn't wire the new onAuthRefresh handler to rotate ephemeral creds. Lots of exponential backoff spam, job never finishes.

lina: quick local patch that unblocks: replace import path and attach new hook:```js
// before
import { LlamaAdapter } from 'redwood.llamaindex_adapter'
// after
import { LlamaAdapter } from '@redwood/integrations/llamaindex'

client.configure({ retry: { onAuthRefresh: async () => await rotateEphemeralToken() } })
```
This fixed import and the auth hang for me.

jon: can you open a small PR with the two-line change + updated ingest worker? We should also update the starter generator template to avoid future breakage.

maria: pushed branch with the fixes and added a tiny README snippet about ephemeral token wiring. Gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/priv-temp (internal).

kevin: proposal: add a lightweight eval/CI job that runs the starter across SDK matrix [0.6.x,0.7.x] and executes `npm run ingest --ci`, asserting 200 response and items > 0. That would catch export reorgs and auth API changes.

sam: agree. cheap smoke test. I can add a Docker-based job that spins the sample container, runs ingest, and tears down.

lina: I'll update docs section "Auth hooks and ephemeral tokens" with the snippet and a note about SDK upgrade steps.

jon: opened draft PR #482 in starter repo and issue #1029 to add CI matrix. tagging @lina for docs and @kevin for eval harness.

maria: thanks all. follow-ups: jon -> finalize PR & template update, lina -> docs + README snippet, kevin -> add CI/eval job, sam -> telemetry for retry flakiness. :tada:
